The '''Kibilini sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] near [[Portmoak sector/Legends|Portmoak sector]].

==Behind the scenes==
The sector was spelled '''Kibilini''' and '''Kiblini''' in [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].
